text:
nina (Support): customer reports promo code WELCOME50 declined when paying with Swiss card (CHF). Error shown: 'promo_not_applicable_region'. they say they'd expect it to work for new signups in europe.

samir (Billing): @nina can you paste the exact payload they used and their account locale/country? promo rules check billing country vs account.locale sometimes causes mismatches.

nina (Support): sure, acct id acct_01G7... , payment method attached via checkout (Stripe). locale in account profile is 'de-CH' and billing_address.country = 'CH'. customer says they chose country=Switzerland in form.

devon (Eng): can you grab the request/response from api logs? likely the eligibility predicate filters on region_group = 'EU' and CH isn't in that set. also we recently changed fallback to use account.locale instead of payment_method.billing_address.country for promo eligibility.

nina (Support): here's the truncated API call (from logs):
```
POST /v1/promos/apply 200ms
{
  "promo_code":"WELCOME50",
  "account_id":"acct_01G7...",
  "billing_country":"CH",
  "currency":"CHF"
}

RESPONSE 400
{
  "error":"promo_not_applicable_region",
  "details":"promo restricted to EU countries (VAT-exempt list)"
}
```

marta (Product): this is expected behavior for this promo: WELCOME50 was intentionally limited to EU member states because we subsidize VAT differently for EU customers. CH is outside EU so it's excluded. But we may want clearer messaging.

nina (Support): customer argues they are located in Zurich and VAT handling should still allow promo for new accounts. they provided VAT/ID? No, they are consumer. they asked for credit instead of refund.

samir (Billing): Important nuance: Switzerland has its own VAT rules and some partners treat CHF as 'EUR-equivalent' regionally but legally it's non-EU. Promo engine checks membership in eu_countries set (DE, FR, IT, ES, AT...). CH not included. If we start including CH we expose the company to different tax treatment and potential VAT reclaim differences.

devon (Eng): quick repro for team: run the promo eligibility endpoint with country=CH and currency=CHF. Code snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/check -d '{"promo_code":"WELCOME50","country":"CH","currency":"CHF","account_locale":"de-CH"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'

# returns: {"eligible":false,"reason":"region_restriction"}
```

marta (Product): for support flow we should either: a) explicitly deny and offer alternative promo for non-EU customers, or b) issue a one-time goodwill credit after review. Need alignment with finance.

samir (Billing): finance suggests we don't change promo territory for WELCOME50. but support can manually issue a credit if approved, recorded as a special adjustment to avoid VAT reporting issues. If issuing credit, tag as 'promo-adjustment-non-eu' and record customer's country.

nina (Support): i'll offer a one-time trial credit and ask for confirmation. can someone approve issuing CHF40 credit (approx equivalent to $40) to keep them on boarded?

marta (Product): approve. please follow adjustment naming and include case id.

samir (Billing): approved — create ledger adjustment with code PROMO-ADJ-CH-1752108765 and mark tax_code = 'out_of_scope_non_eu'. do not apply VAT.

billing-bot: Ledger adjustment created: id adj_9A3... amount CHF40 status pending.

devon (Eng): small follow-up: we should update promo engine error message to be more explicit: 'promo not eligible for country: CH — WELCOME50 only valid in EU member states. Contact support for assistance.' That should reduce confusion.

marta (Product): agreed. @devon can you file a tiny ticket to change error text and include a link to support doc?

devon (Eng): will do. created ticket RDW-2718. ETA next week.

nina (Support): customer notified, credit pending (adj_9A3...). they replied :thumbsup: and will retry checkout. leaving thread open until ledger shows complete.

billing-bot: Ledger adjustment adj_9A3... status: completed.

nina (Support): confirmed with customer — payment went through after credit applied. closing. case id: 2026-4529.

marta (Product): small action items captured: 1) update error wording on promo API (RDW-2718) 2) add support KB about 'EU-only promos and non-EU exceptions' 3) finance to publish guidance on manual credits.

samir (Billing): tagging for finance follow-up: will draft guidance and share in #finance next week.

devon (Eng): also adding a unit test for promo eligibility with locale/account country vs payment_method.billing_address precedence — to avoid regressions.

nina (Support): thanks everyone!
